breakdown.description: The wall is described as two layers in series but also treated as parallel heat-flow paths; two layers in series should be analyzed as series thermal resistances; series and parallel conduction models are mutually exclusive.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the two layers as series thermal resistances, summing R₁ and R₂ to get R_total. It does not mention parallel heat-flow paths, which was the erroneous instruction in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which simply says to neglect contact resistance without specifying parallel paths.
